sentences.text:
The appeal is filed on the ground that learned Tribunal erred in passing order of pay and recover after considering the fact that deceased was travelling on the loader at the time of road accident,
which breaches terms and conditions of the policy.

It is also submitted that learned Tribunal has no jurisdiction to pass order of pay and recover yet, learned Tribunal erred in directing insurance company to pay and recover the same from the driver and owner of the vehicle.

sentences.text: The issue is no more res-integra in view of jud Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of Shamanna v. Oriental Insurance Co. Ltd., (2018) 9 SCC 650 and Shivaraj V/s Rajendra and another reported in 2018 ACJ 2755.

sentences.text: 4. In the present case, learned Tribunal accepted argument of Insurance Company that deceased was travelling on the loader at the time of road accident and therefore, exonerated Insurance Company.

However, since claimant was third party, learned Tribunal passed order that Insurance Company at first instance shall pay the amount of compensation and recover the same from the driver and owner of offending vehicle.
5. In view of above, I see no reason in the anomaly in the order passed by the learned Tribunal.

The learned Tribunal has rightly believed that deceased was third party and claimants are asking for passing of third party, cannot be made sufferer on the technical breach of terms and conditions of the policy.
Order of pay and recover passed by the learned Tribunal is maintained.
6. In wake of above reasons, the appeal sans merits and accordingly, it is dismissed.
Record and proceedings be sent back to the concerned Tribunal, forthwith.

opennyai_summary.arguments: It is also submitted that learned Tribunal has no jurisdiction to pass order of pay and recover yet, learned Tribunal erred in directing insurance company to pay and recover the same from the driver and owner of the vehicle.
opennyai_summary.ANALYSIS:
The issue is no more res-integra in view of jud Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of Shamanna v. Oriental Insurance Co. Ltd., (2018) 9 SCC 650 and Shivaraj V/s Rajendra and another reported in 2018 ACJ 2755.
However, since claimant was third party, learned Tribunal passed order that Insurance Company at first instance shall pay the amount of compensation and recover the same from the driver and owner of offending vehicle.
The learned Tribunal has rightly believed that deceased was third party and claimants are asking for passing of third party, cannot be made sufferer on the technical breach of terms and conditions of the policy.

Order of pay and recover passed by the learned Tribunal is maintained.
6. In wake of above reasons, the appeal sans merits and accordingly, it is dismissed.
Record and proceedings be sent back to the concerned Tribunal, forthwith.
